# 燃气涡轮性能阅读指南

_Gas Turbine Performance — Reading Guide_

参考书：Philip P. Walsh、Paul Fletcher，《Gas Turbine Performance》，英文第 2 版，2004。本站以其官方目录为结构参考，围绕公开资料编写入门导读。

_Reference: Philip P. Walsh and Paul Fletcher, Gas Turbine Performance, second edition, 2004. Its official contents inform this site’s organisation; the introductory notes connect to public references._

## 怎样用这本书 / How to Use the Book

先把整机性能看成任务、部件、工况、验证和使用之间的联系，再按问题回到章节。下面是本站整理的主题映射，并非原书目录的逐项翻译。

_First connect mission needs, components, operating conditions, evidence and service. Return to the relevant chapters as questions arise. The map below is a curated study route rather than a line-by-line contents translation._

## 三个阅读问题 / Three Reading Questions

整机匹配：一个部件的改变，如何影响其他部件的工作点与功率平衡？

_Whole-engine matching: how does a component change affect other operating points and the power balance?_

全工况：设计点上的收益，能否延续到其他环境、稳态和瞬态工况？

_Operating envelope: do design-point benefits persist under different environments and steady or transient conditions?_

全寿命：试验如何支持结论，退化、维护与成本如何改变方案判断？

_Service life: how do tests support the conclusions, and how do deterioration, maintenance and cost affect the assessment?_
